{{Top|leg|title=j'ber J'Kek}}
'''J'ber J'Kek''' was an influential clan on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] before [[Se'Lenti|the Scouring]] that specialized in politics. Its members included the [[Rel'Kan]], [[J'Kek D'rith Kalama]] and the [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] [[J'Kek M'hoy Trinia]]. The [[j'ber]] was wiped out during the Scouring.
